This is the quickest and best method I have found. It literally takes about two minutes.

  1. Pull out your desired number of tortillas ( I wouldn't do more than 8 at a time) separate them and run them under the faucet just enough to get them wet on both sides.
  2. Get out a small plate and a glass bowl large enough to cover it.
  3. Place tortillas in the middle of the plate and cover with the bowl upside down.
  4. Put in the microwave and cook for about 40-50 seconds.
  5. Serve!!!

Note that try to keep them covered until you are ready to eat, if you leave them uncovered they will quickly dry out.
